fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Single-Diode + Lumped Thermal ODE
description: First-principles single-diode (Shockley) OPV cell with high ideality factor and significant series/shunt resistance (low fill factor). Full I-V / P-V by root-finding, MPP by bracketed maximisation, irradiance + temperature dependence, and a lumped energy-balance thermal ODE integrated with scipy.solve_ivp.
source: Shockley (1949) Bell Syst. Tech. J. 28, 435; De Soto et al. (2006) Solar Energy 80(1), 78-88; Brabec et al. (2010) Adv. Mater. 22, 3839-3856; Faiman (2008) Prog. Photovolt. 16(4), 307-315; Kawano et al. (2006) J. Appl. Phys. 100, 033514; Zhang et al. (2018) Adv. Energy Mater. 8(6), 1701567; Cuce et al. (2013) low-light OPV characterisation

unit.name: OPV NFA module (PM6:Y6-type, n~1.7) — physics-lumped single cell-string

I_L_ref.note: String photocurrent at STC (G=1000 W/m2, 25C); Jsc ~7.25 mA/cm2 over per-cell area 16 cm2 (800 cm2 module / 50 series cells). This is the SERIES-STRING current (not multiplied by N_s).

I0_ref.note: Diode saturation (dark) current at T_ref; high for organics due to defect/CT-state recombination

n.note: Diode ideality factor; high (>1.5) in OPV due to trap-assisted/CT-state recombination (Brabec 2010)

N_s.note: Cells in series in the module string; multiplies the per-cell thermal voltage

Rs.note: Series resistance; large due to low carrier mobility in organic transport layers -> low fill factor

Rsh.note: Shunt resistance; moderate, set by morphological defects -> low fill factor; scaled as Rsh_ref*G_ref/G so it grows at low light (good low-light/indoor behaviour)

alpha_sc.note: String Isc temperature coefficient (+0.024 mA/K); slight positive tempco typical of OPV, scaled to string current

Eg_ref.note: Effective charge-transfer-state energy gap (below optical bandgap ~1.6 eV) governing I0(T)

dEgdT.note: Temperature coefficient of effective CT-state gap

area.note: Module active area (800 cm2) for efficiency normalisation

absorptance.note: Fraction of incident irradiance absorbed as heat+power by the thin-film stack

m_cp.note: Lumped module heat capacity (thin lightweight flexible substrate -> low thermal mass)

U_loss.note: Combined convective+radiative loss coefficient to ambient (Faiman-style)

notes.low_light: OPV retains high relative efficiency at low/indoor irradiance (the shunt-limited regime is favourable); modelled through the single-diode shunt branch (Cuce 2013).
notes.flexible: Lightweight flexible substrate -> small thermal mass m_cp, fast thermal response.
notes.degradation: Real OPV degrades faster than Si/perovskite (burn-in + photo-oxidation, T80 of months-years). Not integrated here; reserved for an F2c degradation sub-fidelity. See Brabec et al. (2010).
